roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse
description:
Join a dedicated team at a leading skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse. This pivotal full-time role offers a unique opportunity to shape the clinical excellence and safety culture of our center, ensuring the highest standards of patient care and staff competency.

In this dual capacity, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, conducting competency assessments, and fostering a continuous learning environment. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention and control efforts, including surveillance, policy development, and staff training to safeguard the health of our residents and team members.

We are seeking a proactive and knowledgeable professional to contribute to our mission. This urgent opening comes with a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, reflecting your expertise and commitment. If you are passionate about clinical education and infection control, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Experience in staff development or clinical education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.
